rationale: Pedro is building AI agent tooling and consumer applications at the intersection of robotics and AI, while Shryas invests in and researches embodied AI systems and robotics infrastructure at Kindred Ventures. Shryas's focus on foundation models, task-specific fine-tuning, and open-source infrastructure directly complements Pedro's work on agent tooling infrastructure, and both share conviction in AI agents' transformative potential.
intro_message: Pedro Nagamine de Lima, meet Shryas Bhurat — Shryas invests in robotics and AI infrastructure at Kindred Ventures and would be valuable context for your work on AI agent tooling at ITA Robio.
